svg.title: Helios-Artemis Dual-MCU Predictive MPPT — Print-Ready Prototype Schematic
svg.desc: Full printable circuit schematic: 50Wp PV panel, INA219 current sense, ESP32-S3 Helios, STM32F103 Artemis, IRFB4110 buck converter with TC4420 gate driver, TSL2591 light sensor, AMS1117 3.3V regulator, SD card, 12V/7Ah SLA battery, CC/CV charging FSM, LSTM-P&O blend law, and component BOM.
svg.text: Prototype schematic · 50Wp SHS · Sylhet deployment · Rev 1.0

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Give me the full spec for the 50Wp monocrystalline PV panel used here')
sendPrompt('How do I wire the INA219 shunt resistor and I2C lines for this circuit?')
sendPrompt('Explain the IRFB4110 synchronous buck converter design, gate drive timing and snubber recommendations')
sendPrompt('Describe the Shepherd OCV and Peukert model parameters for the 12V 7Ah SLA battery')
sendPrompt('How does the TSL2591 act as an irradiance proxy for MPPT prediction?')
sendPrompt('What firmware tasks run on the ESP32-S3 Helios core? How is the LSTM inference structured?')
sendPrompt('What STM32F103 timer and ADC configuration drives the 50kHz PWM and INA219 reads?')
sendPrompt('AMS1117 3.3V regulator wiring: input caps, output caps, and current budget for ESP32-S3 + STM32')
sendPrompt('What data format and columns does the Helios SD card log for LSTM training?')
sendPrompt('How does the STM32 implement constant-current bulk charging with the IRFB4110?')
sendPrompt('Constant-voltage absorption stage: how does Artemis regulate to 14.7V with PWM feedback?')
sendPrompt('What voltage and hysteresis does the float stage use for the 12V SLA?')
sendPrompt('Explain the alpha blend coefficient tuning between LSTM prediction and P&O in the Helios-Artemis MPPT')
g.text: V_ref = (1−α) · V_ref,P&O + α · V_MPP,pred α ∈ [0.20, 0.55] · optimal α ≈ 0.35
Fires only when |Ĝ − G| / G > 0.15 · 20-step cooldown after each blend event

svg.text: L=100 μH, C=470 μF, PCB & housing
